title: KnockOutEZ/wigolo
claim: KnockOutEZ/wigolo — The go-to web for your AI coding agent — local-first search, fetch, crawl & research over MCP. No API keys, no cloud, $0
why_good: Gives coding agents local-first web search/fetch/crawl over MCP with zero keys or cloud — kills a real cost + privacy pain for agent users.
value: Freemium: free local core, paid team/enterprise tier for shared crawls, rate limits and hosted convenience.
risk: MCP + the agent vendors may bundle web access natively, and a local crawler's coverage is hard to keep ahead of hosted search.
pick_reason: The project is too vague and lacks a clear monetizable product.

zh.claim: KnockOutEZ/wigolo —— 给 AI 编码 agent 的网页入口:通过 MCP 做本地优先的搜索/抓取/爬取/调研。无需 API key、无需云、$0。
zh.why_good: 让编码 agent 通过 MCP 做零 key、零云的本地优先网页搜索/抓取/爬取——干掉了 agent 用户真实的成本 + 隐私痛点。
zh.value: 免费增值:本地核心免费,团队/企业版收费(共享爬取、限流、托管省心)。
zh.risk: MCP + agent 厂商可能原生内置网页访问,而"本地爬虫"的覆盖很难持续领先托管搜索。
